description: This file defines the AppDatabase class for managing local database operations, including schema setup with tables for downloads, download queue, and watch history, as well as opening and closing the database.

classes.name: AppDatabase
classes.description: Provides methods to open, initialize, and close the local SQLite database with specific tables for downloads, queue, and watch history.

methods.name: open
methods.description: Initializes the database if not already opened, sets up the schema with tables and initial data.
